Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 [Bagra Army] or [Twilight] trait Digimon card from your hand or trash under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞.

[All Turns] When any of your [Bagra Army] or [Twilight] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements would be played, by suspending this Tamer, 1 card from under your Tamers and 1 card in your trash can also be placed for their DigiXros.
(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Yuu Amano]/[Nene Amano].
